title: Ember Bricks
author: OXT-Beyond contributors
description: A brick breaker for a phone, a tablet or a desktop. Every brick you break heats the ball, and a hot ball scores up to five times as much. Catch the sparks that fall (a wide paddle, more balls, a fireball, bolts, a net) and let the dark ones drop. Twenty-four levels that come round again faster, and an Online Duel for two over the internet: meet in the lobby or swap two codes, each on your own wall, and a hot streak sends your rival trouble.
